notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.36.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Kiem tra va cham giua cac bo mon Kien truc / Ket cau / Dieu hoa-Thong gio / Dien / Nuoc / PCCC / Ha tang, trong model hien tai va trong cac link Revit; bo mon tu dinh nghia theo category + loc theo type / he thong. - Ma tran cap bo mon voi dung sai xuyen (mm) va khoang ho (mm); tu bo qua phan tu host-long, da join, noi connector, bao on. - Ket qua: muc do (Nghiem trong / Lon / Nho), tang, truc, phan tu A/B, trang thai Moi / Dang xu ly / Da duyet / Da xu ly / Bo qua / Da het giu qua cac lan chay lai (luu file <ten model>.vacham.xml canh file .rvt), giao viec + ghi chu.
